i.norm: Verifies that chompBalanced on a queue containing only a single-quote returns the entire queue contents (because the quote char is treated as content, not as an unmatched open/close delimiter), and that the queue is empty afterwards so consumeElementSelector returns a different string.
Queue contains a single single-quote character
chompBalanced with open=')' and close='$': the "'" is neither delimiter, so it is accumulated as quoted content and returned as-is.
The queue is now empty; consumeElementSelector returns an empty string, which is not equal to the previously returned single-quote string.
